headline: Seahawks Rule Out QB Sam Darnold For Week 2
summary: As expected, the Seahawks will be without their starting quarterback in Week 2. Head coach Mike Macdonald confirmed on Wednesday that Sam Darnold will miss Seattle’s upcoming game against the Cardinals. headline: Nico Collins hurt his hamstring in Wednesday's practice
summary: Texans wide receiver Nico Collins was listed as a limited participant in Wednesday's practice due to a hamstring injury that took place during the session.

headline: 49ers Place TE Jake Tonges On IR

headline: Colts WR Keenan Allen Formally Charged With Two Misdemeanors
summary: Colts wide receiver Keenan Allen was arrested on misdemeanor charges of DWI and DWI endangering a person on Aug. 30. Allen has now been formally charged with operating a vehicle with an alcohol concentration equivalent of 0.15 or more and operating a vehicle while intoxicated, Nathan Brown of the Indianapolis Star reports.
